chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan, from his father, from ʿAlī ibn ʿUqbah, from his father, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Concerning a woman who observed iʿtikaf, then she menstruated.
So he said: “She returns; there is no iʿtikaf for her.”

key_terms.اعْتَكَفَتْ: she observed iʿtikaf; she entered devotional retreat
key_terms.اعْتِكَافٌ: iʿtikaf; devotional retreat in the mosque
key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman; the legal subject mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.تَرْجِعُ: she returns; she must leave and go back

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman menstruates during iʿtikaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a woman who enters iʿtikaf and then begins menstruation. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that she must return, and her iʿtikaf does not continue in that state.
